 JUSTICE K.R. MOHAPATRA  JUSTICE SANJAY KUMAR MISHRA  ORDER  Order No. 03.02.2026  W.P.(C) No. 3327 OF 2026  1. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
2. Issue notice.
2.1 Requisites for issuance of notice to Opposite Parties Speed Post with AD shall be filed by 6th February, 2026.

3. Petitioner, in this Writ Petition, seeks to assail the order dated 6th January, 2026 passed by the Competent Authority, Land Acquisition-cum-Tahasildar, Deogarh, wherein, he observed that if no stay order is received within thirty days from the date of such order, compensation amount shall be disbursed in favour of the claimants.
4.

It is submitted by Mr. Jena, learned counsel that the Petitioner claiming to be a co-sharer, has filed an application under Section 3H (4) of the National Highways Authority Act, 1956 (for brevity,
'the Act'), to refer the matter to the Civil Court for

Order dated 6th January, 2026 passed by the CALA reveals that such an application was received by him on 30th October, 2025.
Even after receipt of the said application, the Tahasildar, Deogarh is bent upon to release the compensation instead of referring the matter to the Civil Court.
5. Mr. Biswal, learned ASC prays for a short adjournment to take instruction in the matter.

6. Since the CALA-cum-Tahasildar, Deogarh has directed to release the compensation, if no stay order is produced within thirty days of passing of such order, this Court feels that the Petitioner deserves interim protection.
7. Accordingly, this Court directs that the compensation amount in LA Case No.1 of 2026 passed under Section 3G of the Act shall not be disbursed till the next date.

8. Put up this matter on 8th April, 2026 along with tracking report of the Postal Department.
 (K.R. Mohapatra)
